measures.definition: People receiving pay through PAYE in the month (average of daily counts), by the employee's place of residence, all industries, not seasonally adjusted; people, not jobs
measures.notes_common_to_every_row: accredited official statistics (Index note 2); allocated by residence of the recipient (Index note 7)

$meta.citation: ONS and HMRC (2026) PAYE RTI, September 2026 edition
